turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call. Owen saw a zero in the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class. Why is it there?
Don't thank me. Owen found out about this on his phone in front of his classmates, and nobody called me first. Sit down if you're going to talk about it, and tell me what you think he did.
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Don't manage me. Owen's marks are the reason I'm here, so you'll need to tell me what you actually think happened to his essay.
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"Just a misunderstanding." Then explain the misunderstanding, Hale, and what you're basing the zero on.
So can we agree he's a good student?
I'm not agreeing to anything yet. Did you enter that zero before you called me?
